body.objective: Students will be able to discuss global issues.
successCriteria: I can discuss global issues in Spanish
I can form the present subjunctive of regular verbs
I can make recommendations with "es importante que" and "recomiendo que"
body.hook: Climate change, poverty, access to clean water, migration: global issues affect Spanish-speaking countries and Canada alike. At the 30 level, you can discuss these issues in Spanish and recommend solutions using one of the most important structures in the language: the subjunctive.

vocabulary.definition: It is important that… (followed by the subjunctive).
I recommend that… (followed by the subjunctive).

study.title: Soluciones globales
study.question: How do I discuss global issues and recommend solutions in Spanish?
study.passage:
Forming the present subjunctive (regular verbs): take the yo form of the present, drop the -o, add the "opposite" endings.
• -ar → -e: hablar (hablo) → hable, hables, hable, hablemos, habléis, hablen
• -er/-ir → -a: comer (como) → coma, comas, coma, comamos, comáis, coman; vivir (vivo) → viva
• Spelling changes keep the sound: reciclar → recicle; proteger → proteja; pagar → pague
Use the subjunctive after expressions of recommendation, necessity or wish with a change of subject:
• Es importante que todos reciclemos.
• Es necesario que el gobierno proteja los bosques.
• Recomiendo que usemos menos plástico.
• Ojalá que más personas tengan agua potable. (tener → tenga)
Reading (short text): "En muchos países de América Latina, el cambio climático afecta la agricultura. En partes de Centroamérica, las sequías hacen más difícil cultivar maíz y frijoles, y algunas familias migran a otras regiones. Los expertos dicen que es importante que los países inviertan en agua potable y en agricultura sostenible."
English support: las sequías = droughts; cultivar = to grow; migran = migrate; inviertan (invertir) = invest; sostenible = sustainable.
Activity: In groups, choose a global issue, research one fact, and write three recommendations using the subjunctive. Present them as a short panel discussion.
study.source: Original text written for this lesson.
steps: Learn to form the present subjunctive
Write three recommendations with the subjunctive
discussion: How does climate change affect agriculture in Central America, according to the text?
Why does "es importante que" take the subjunctive?
Which recommendation from your group is strongest, and why?
study.product: Write a short opinion piece (10–12 sentences) on a global issue, including at least one fact, two problems and four recommendations using the subjunctive.

examples.title: Forming
examples.problem: Form the subjunctive of hablar with nosotros.

examples.title: Recommendation
examples.problem: Say "I recommend that we use less water."

examples.title: Ojalá
examples.problem: Say "I hope everyone has drinking water."
examples.answer: Ojalá que todos tengan agua potable.

practice.q: Form the subjunctive of comer with yo.
Form the subjunctive of vivir with ellos.
Form the subjunctive of reciclar with nosotros.
Form the subjunctive of tener with ellos.
What do droughts make harder in Central America?

practice.a: G changes to j to keep the same sound.

practice.q: Why is the subjunctive used in "Recomiendo que usemos…"?
practice.a: It follows a recommendation with a change of subject.

practice.q: Translate "It is necessary that the government invest in clean energy."
practice.a: Es necesario que el gobierno invierta en energía limpia.

practice.q: Write a sentence connecting a global issue to Canada.
practice.a: Sample: Es importante que Canadá reduzca sus emisiones.

misconceptions: Using the indicative after "es importante que"
Using the subjunctive without a change of subject
exitTicket: Form the subjunctive of two regular verbs.
Write one recommendation with the subjunctive.

items.q: The subjunctive here needs
Name three global issues in Spanish.
items.answer: El cambio climático, la pobreza, la migración.

items.q: What follows "recomiendo que"?
Explain how to form the present subjunctive.
items.answer: Take the yo form, drop -o, add opposite endings (-e for -ar, -a for -er/-ir).

items.q: Write two recommendations with the subjunctive.
items.answer: Sample: Es importante que reciclemos. Recomiendo que ahorremos agua.

items.q: Summarize the reading.
items.answer: Climate change and droughts make farming harder in Central America; experts recommend investing in water and sustainable farming.

items.q: Explain the spelling change in pagar → pague.
items.answer: G becomes gu to keep the hard g sound before e.

items.q: Write an opinion piece on a global issue.
Explain why global issues matter to both Canada and the Spanish-speaking world.
items.answer: Issues like climate change and migration cross borders and need shared solutions.
